revisions.description:
Clear the cell data in the specified range from a Google spreadsheet.
The supported range notations are A1 notation and R1C1 notation.

changelog.reason: Service Account Key takes the whole JSON key file; Client Email and Private Key stay for revisions that use them

params.label: Service Account Key
params.helpertext: The service account's whole JSON key file, pasted as-is. Replaces Client Email and Private Key
params.name: serviceAccountKey

params.label: Private Key
params.helpertext: The service account's private key. Not needed when Service Account Key is set
params.name: privateKey

params.label: Client Email
params.helpertext: The service account's client email. Not needed when Service Account Key is set
params.name: clientEmail

params.description: You can find the spreadsheet ID in a Google Sheets URL:  https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/spreadsheetId/edit#gid=sheetId
params.label: Spreadsheet ID
params.helpertext: The ID of the desired spreadsheet
params.name: spreadsheetId

params.description: Supports A1 notation: https://developers.google.com/sheets/api/guides/concepts#expandable-1 and R1C1 notation: https://developers.google.com/sheets/api/guides/concepts#expandable-2
params.label: Data Ranges
params.helpertext: The data ranges to clear separated by a comma
params.name: ranges
